endpoints.description: Returns API readiness for infrastructure probes.
The same health payload on the client-facing prefix.

endpoints.summary: Resource inventory with status and category
endpoints.description: Categories are read from resource manifests, not from a table in code.
The committed document with effective values resolved through the configuration resolution order.

endpoints.summary: Apply an RFC 7386 JSON Merge Patch to operator state
endpoints.description: The only write. Named fields change; every other field is preserved, including fields this binary does not model. A null removes a key. The merged document is schema-validated before the write; a rejection names the failing path and leaves the stored document untouched.
Every scenario with system_required, runtime kind, auto-restart recommendation, effective operator choice, and declared scenario and resource dependencies.
Required resources derived from the closure and locked; optional resources declared through optional_dependencies; standalone resources no selected scenario requires.

endpoints.summary: Transitive closure of the current selection
endpoints.description: Every scenario and resource the selection implies, with the reason each member entered the set. Replaces the retired setup-order endpoint.

endpoints.summary: Deployment union for the current selection
endpoints.description: The union of scenarios, resources, tools, and safeguards a bundle, VPS, or bridged host must carry to run the selection.

endpoints.summary: Credential descriptors for the selected stack
endpoints.description: Descriptor label, description, obtain_url, required flag, and configured status. Never returns a credential value.

endpoints.summary: Operator-controllable surface declared by the catalog
endpoints.description: Every decision an operator may make, with type, schema, risk, privilege, and default. Drives generic form rendering and configuration discovery.

endpoints.summary: Apply the committed selection to the host
endpoints.description: Installs opted-in tools, applies opted-in safeguards, enables resources, and starts scenarios by delegating to control-plane handlers. Idempotent. A failing item skips its dependants and the run is recorded as partially applied.

endpoints.summary: Per-item report for an apply run

endpoints.description: The step pointer, which steps are satisfied, and the first unsatisfied step. Shared state, so another surface resumes at the same step.

endpoints.summary: Host tools and safeguards for the selection
endpoints.description: Derived from selected manifests with risk, privilege, bundling, supported platforms, and any declared safeguard config schema.
Probes credentials, host tools, host safeguards, and resource reachability. Every non-ready item names a remediation. Never returns a credential value.

endpoints.summary: Relay a credential value to the credential authority
endpoints.description: Accepts the value only in the request body and returns only logical_id and field. The value is never written to operator state, logs, URLs, or any response.
Distinguishes an unset value, an unreachable secure store, and a host with no backend, and names the fix for each.
Requires confirm=true in the request body.
Entries are read from manifests, not from a table in code.
